name: Rudolstadt (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Rudolstadt (a yellow lion on green).
history: Municipal flag of Rudolstadt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rudolstadt arms — yellow lion on green
